content.focus: Exercise, mental health, neurodevelopmental issues, and endocarditis in congenital heart disease.

sections.title: Exercise and Sports
details: Lapse of care is a predictor of morbidity in adults with congenital heart disease.
Physical activity in congenital heart disease shows various benefits, including psychological effects and influence on mortality.
Specific recommendations for exercise and competitive sports participation are provided based on individual capacity and associated risks.

sections.title: Mental Health and Neurodevelopmental Issues
details: Anxiety and depression prevalent among congenital heart disease patients.
Neurodevelopmental outcomes and strategies to support cognitive development are addressed.

sections.title: Endocarditis Prevention
details: Guidelines on the prevention of infective endocarditis in patients with congenital heart disease.

genes.context: Validation of association of the apolipoprotein E2 allele with neurodevelopmental dysfunction after cardiac surgery in neonates and infants.
